procedure.cmd: SB=$(scripts/dev-sandbox.sh new --name p12-inst-$$ | tail -1) && { scripts/dev-sandbox.sh run "$SB" -- bash -c 'bin/swissknifeman install --units harness,brain --force --bin-dir "$HOME/.local/bin" && for c in swissknifeman harness brain; do test -x "$HOME/.local/bin/$c" || exit 1; done'; rc=$?; scripts/dev-sandbox.sh remove "$SB" >/dev/null; exit $rc; }
